description: Second pilot after pilot-v1 review: cumulative token cap raised to 300k, fixture provenance neutralized, pre-incident payment history (120 payments) in every workspace, and two cases whose traceback does not name the boundary (S4 response-mismatch, S5 stale-retry) alongside S1-S3. 2 models x 3 arms x 5 cases x 2 repetitions = 60 trials. Pilot results do not enter the main estimate.
notes: Protocol changes from pilot-v1 (owner decisions 2026-09-06): token_cap 100000 -> 300000; packaged fixtures carry a neutral provenance note; history and S4/S5 added. Case versions are 2. Requires owner approval of batch_usd_cap before `harness run`.
